subject: History
description: Mughals from Babur to Aurangzeb — reigns, policies, administrative systems

questions.stem: The FOUNDER of the Mughal dynasty in India was:
questions.explanation: Zahir-ud-din Muhammad Babur — defeated Ibrahim Lodi at the First Battle of Panipat (1526) and founded the Mughal empire. Descendant of Timur (paternal) and Chengiz Khan (maternal). Wrote the Baburnama (Turki).
questions.subject: History

questions.stem: Which Mughal emperor is known for introducing the DIN-I-ILAHI?
questions.explanation: Akbar — founded Din-i-Ilahi in 1582 — a syncretic religious movement blending elements of various faiths. Also known for: Mansabdari system, Todar Mal's land revenue system (Dahsala), the Ibadat Khana dialogues at Fatehpur Sikri.
questions.subject: History

questions.stem: Match the MUGHAL EMPEROR with their court POET/SCHOLAR. A. Akbar.  B. Jahangir.  C. Shah Jahan.  D. Aurangzeb. List-II: 1. Abul Fazl.  2. Nur Jahan (patron of poetry).  3. Abdul Hamid Lahori (Badshahnama).  4. Mustaid Khan (Maasir-i-Alamgiri).
questions.explanation: Abul Fazl — Akbar's court historian, author of Akbarnama and Ain-i-Akbari. Nur Jahan — Jahangir's consort, patron of arts. Lahori — wrote Badshahnama under Shah Jahan. Mustaid Khan — Maasir-i-Alamgiri on Aurangzeb's reign.
questions.subject: History

questions.stem: Shah Jahan was imprisoned by his son ___ in the Agra Fort until his death (1666):
questions.explanation: Aurangzeb deposed and imprisoned Shah Jahan in June 1658 after winning the war of succession against Dara Shikoh, Murad Baksh, Shah Shuja. Shah Jahan spent 8 years in captivity in Agra Fort (Muthamman Burj), allegedly gazing at the Taj Mahal.
questions.subject: History

questions.stem: The MANSABDARI SYSTEM was introduced by:
questions.explanation: Akbar — introduced the Mansabdari system c. 1571 — bureaucratic grading of Mughal nobles by 'zat' (personal rank) and 'sawar' (cavalry rank). Replaced the earlier Iqta system. Highest rank was held by princes of the royal family.
questions.subject: History

questions.stem: The LAST Mughal Emperor (exiled to Rangoon after the 1857 Revolt) was:
questions.explanation: Bahadur Shah Zafar II — proclaimed emperor by rebel sepoys on 11 May 1857, deposed after recapture of Delhi, exiled to Rangoon (Burma) in 1858 where he died in 1862. Poet in Urdu; his 'Lagta nahin hai ji mera' is famous.
questions.subject: History

questions.stem: Aurangzeb reimposed the JIZYA tax on non-Muslims in India in the year:
questions.explanation: Aurangzeb reimposed Jizya in 1679 (abolished by Akbar in 1564). Also reimposed pilgrimage tax on Hindus. Led to widespread resentment; contributed to Rajput and Maratha resistance. Aurangzeb died in 1707.
